title: Story premise EDU004: Same Fence, Different Garden
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: They have the same fence. Do they get the same garden? Takeaway/theme: Perimeter measures a boundary; area measures the enclosed surface.
description: Two gardeners each receive twelve fence segments and want the largest rectangular planting area. Their first rectangles enclose different tile counts; rearranging the same segments reveals why equal perimeters need not give equal areas.
